messages:
anna: Heads-up — I see eu-west3-gpu spot_avail_score tanking from ~0.95 to ~0.60 in the last 10m. eviction_rate spiked, and some batch jobs got throttled. https://dash.internal/evictions?pool=eu-west3-gpu

mike: On it. Is this across all SKUs or just the V100/A100 class?

sara: I rolled an autoscaler tweak ~35m ago; could be correlated. What time did the spike start?

ops-bot: ALERT: spot_pool_degradation triggered for pool=eu-west3-gpu at 2026-03-18T12:03:42Z (ts: 1772002222). metrics: eviction_rate=0.028, headroom_ratio=0.12, recent_alloc_fails=14. severity=high :rotating_light:

jordan: Can we get a quick breakdown by instance_type? Also want to check recent regional capacity notices from CSP.

linda: Current alert rule we're using (simplified):
```yaml
expr: (sum(evictions{pool="eu-west3-gpu"}) / sum(total_allocations{pool="eu-west3-gpu"})) > 0.02
for: 5m
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  runbook: https://runbooks/infrastructure/spot-interruptions
```

anna: FYI the eviction_rate hit 0.028 around 12:00 and stayed >0.02 for ~9m. The weird bit: only medium-duration jobs are failing; long-running reserved tasks are unaffected.

mike: That suggests capacity pressure from new bursty allocations. I'm spinning up a synthetic batch to repro. If we can reproduce, we can validate whether our backoff window is too short.

sara: Also noticed increased cross-region latency for scheduling — possibly control-plane throttling. I'll check API error rates.

jordan: Proposal: add a composite metric 'spot_avail_score' that combines eviction_rate, headroom_ratio, and recent_alloc_fails so alerts are less noisy. Rough draft formula:
```text
spot_avail_score = clamp(0, 1, 1 - (eviction_rate / 0.05) - (0.5 * (1 - headroom_ratio)) - (recent_alloc_fails / 100))
```

linda: Nice. With that we can also add a graded alert (warning vs page) and auto-trigger scaling to dedicated pool when score < 0.6 for 10m.

anna: Runbook steps I'm executing now: 1) tag canaries to float to other regions, 2) increase scheduling backoff to 45s for spot allocations, 3) open a limited capacity fallback to dedicated instances for latency-sensitive routes.

mike: Commands I ran to push the backoff tweak:
```bash
toolctl patch autoscaler eu-west3-gpu --set spot_backoff=45s --reason "temp: eviction wave"
kubectl rollout restart ds/gpu-scheduler -n infra
```

ops-bot: ACTION_LOG: autoscaler eu-west3-gpu patched by mike at 2026-03-18T12:08:10Z

jordan: We should also instrument an eviction_heatmap by AZ + instance_type and add it to the Ops home dashboard. That will help decide whether to throttle certain SKUs.

sara: I pulled API error logs — got a burst of 429s from provider at 11:56-12:04. I'll correlate with provider status page and open a support ticket if needed.

linda: For alert tuning: recommended changes
- warning when spot_avail_score < 0.75 for 10m (notify #eng-infra)
- page when spot_avail_score < 0.6 for 5m (page oncall)
- suppress pages if region maintenance annotation present from provider

anna: Quick checklist for next 24h:
- Add eviction_heatmap to dashboard (jordan)
- Ship spot_avail_score metric to prometheus (mike)
- Add CSP rate-limit watcher to provider-integrations (sara)
- Draft cost impact note for Finance: estimate cost delta if we shift 10% of workload to dedicated for 6h

mike: I'll emit spot_avail_score as a recording rule:
```yaml
- record: infra:spot_avail_score:ratio
  expr: clamp(0,1, 1 - (sum(evictions)/sum(total_allocations))/0.05 - 0.5*(1 - avg(headroom_ratio)))
```

ops-bot: NOTE: suppression started for canaries pool=eu-west3-gpu until 2026-03-18T13:00:00Z per anna

anna: I also added a temporary routing policy to prefer eu-west1 and us-west2 for low-latency production traffic. Will revert once score recovers. :thumbsup:

jordan: If this repeats nightly we need a long-term strategy: mixed-capacity pools that reserve minimal dedicated headroom for SLO-critical routes and aggressive spot for batch. Open to modeling PRs.

sara: Filing a provider support ticket and will paste ticket id here when available.

linda: Thanks team. Keep updates in-thread and we can convert to a short postmortem if this meets the incident criteria.

anna: Update: spot_avail_score climbed to 0.78 after backoff + routing change. eviction_rate down to 0.009. Keeping watch for 30m. :white_check_mark:
